text: The cafeteria should introduce the plant-based menu. Given the nutritionist-reviewed rotation meets every nutritional requirement, it is the most compelling evidence for introducing the new menu. A live fermentation station would provide a fresh and authentic taste, ensuring that the menu aligns with the values of sustainability and health. With the seasonal produce contract savings offsetting the new equipment within a year, it seems reasonable to proceed. However, I would also recommend that the cafeteria consider adding a section on the menu's benefits to the students, emphasizing how the plant-based menu can contribute to a healthier and more environmentally friendly campus.
